meta.name: qa
meta.description: Interactive QA session where user reports bugs or issues conversationally, and the agent files GitHub issues. Explores the codebase in the background for context and domain language. Use when user wants to report bugs, do QA, file issues conversationally, or mentions "QA session".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对话方式提交 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用聊天方式记录和提交软件缺陷
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to report bugs and file issues via chat

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你以对话方式描述遇到的 Bug 或问题，然后自动在 GitHub 上创建 issue。它会先简单提问澄清，同时后台浏览代码库以理解项目术语，最后生成面向用户、不涉及代码细节的 issue。
howto.when: 当你想要报告 Bug、进行 QA 测试、以对话方式提交 issue，或说出“QA session”时触发。

say.text: 我们来做一个 QA 会话，我遇到了一个 Bug。
say.note: 启动 QA 会话流程。

say.text: 提交一个 issue：点击保存按钮后页面没有反应。
say.note: 直接描述问题，Claude 会帮你创建 issue。

say.text: 这个 Bug 只在 Chrome 中出现，Firefox 正常。
say.note: 提供额外上下文，帮助 Claude 更准确描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to describe bugs or issues conversationally, then automatically create GitHub issues. It asks a few clarifying questions, explores the codebase in the background for context and domain language, and generates user-facing issues without internal code details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to report bugs, do QA, file issues conversationally, or mention "QA session".

say_en.text: Let's have a QA session, I found a bug.
File an issue: clicking the save button does nothing.
say_en.note: Directly describes the problem; Claude will create the issue.

say_en.text: This bug only happens in Chrome, not Firefox.
say_en.note: Provides extra context for a better issue description.
